- Mortgaging would reduce my net worth with no benefit

- My monopoly is already complete; no single property improves it

**The Critical Next Step:**
I need to reach my main turn phase to build houses on my pink monopoly. That's where the game shifts from acquisition to execution. Ending this post-turn action phase now allows me to do that.
